sections.name: Proactive Response
sections.blurb: Tell it what to watch for, or what to count. It stays silent while nothing happens and speaks up the moment it does.

examples.title: Tell me when the toast pops
examples.model: Watches 8 frames per second and decides every second: stay silent or speak up

examples.title: Alert the driver to a pedestrian
examples.model: Watches 8 frames per second and decides every second: stay silent or speak up

examples.title: Count as it happens

sections.name: Perception
sections.blurb: Ask about what is happening right now. It has already seen everything up to this moment, so it answers right away.

examples.title: Follow the action as it happens
examples.model: Asked while the video plays: it has already seen everything up to now

examples.title: Check on a pet
examples.model: Asked while the video plays: it has already seen everything up to now

sections.name: Memory
sections.blurb: Ask about something that happened earlier. It answers from the captions it wrote while watching and the recent frames it still holds.

examples.title: Remember every ingredient
examples.model: Writes captions as it watches, then answers a question about earlier moments

sections.name: All at once
sections.when: Watching, remembering and answering in one stream
sections.blurb: One video: something to watch for from the start, a question in the middle, and a question about earlier at the end, while it keeps writing its memory.
